M-WIDGET-ENGINE.Purpose: Per-context UI orchestrator and facade exposing tree, layout and geometry data for widget integration, extensions and diagnostics.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ProcessUI orchestration, lifecycle, signal posting and facade queries, including direct Flexbox Node access through GetNode.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Engine-owned geometry builder/snapshot, read-only transform and clip services, hit tester and FocusManager lifetimes.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Geometry construction belongs to M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY; coordinate and clip queries belong to M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE and M-CLIP-SERVICE; pointer targeting belongs to M-FLEX-EVENTS.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Native event bubbling and focus registration internals — owned by M-FLEX-EVENTS and M-FOCUS-MANAGER.

Requirements.REQ-001: ProcessUI dispatches native input using the previous geometry snapshot, reconciles root and rect changes, consumes the signal queue once, calculates layout when dirty and captures geometry/clips once before render.
Requirements.REQ-002: DidLayoutCalculationHappenThisCycle reports whether layout ran in the current ProcessUI call.
Requirements.REQ-003: Key is an immutable non-blank string; the parameterless constructor generates an auto:GUID key.
Requirements.REQ-004: Shutdown is idempotent and safely tears down owned widget resources.
Requirements.REQ-005: WidgetRenderer consumes snapshot paint order and owns GUI.matrix scopes, standard child clipping and render orchestration through paired widget hooks and explicit ChildrenGuiSpace results.
Requirements.REQ-006: Native child-transform changes during rendering request a geometry rebuild from the engine; renderer never computes layout.
Requirements.REQ-007: Consumed signals execute their Action and mark layout dirty only while their non-null Source remains mounted in this engine; signals with no Source remain engine-scoped. The queue is drained once before the conditional layout pass.
Requirements.REQ-008: GetNode is an explicit integration and diagnostic escape hatch; it exposes the actual Flexbox node rather than an independent copy or replacement ownership model.

Inputs.IN-002: availableRect: host Rect and current native Unity Event.

Outputs.OUT-001: Tree instances, direct Flexbox Node access, layout results, shared geometry snapshot, query services and DidLayoutCalculationHappenThisCycle.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Reconciles instance tree, dispatches input and issues native IMGUI draw calls.
